The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The defense attempts to shift the issue from ethical accountability (WHO/WHY) to a technical jurisdictional dispute (WHERE). The physical location of the affair does not erase the digital and professional intrusion into the marriage.

Sinema executed a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using her institutional power to extract personal desires from a subordinate, then projecting a procedural defense to avoid transparency. This prioritizes self-interest over public trust and ethical standards.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public officials must be held to ethical standards both in office and in their treatment of subordinates.
The Unavoidable Lie: Jurisdictional technicalities can erase the ethical reality of using public office to facilitate personal affairs.
